PassiveDesc.Name: Sanity System - Messy Sewing
PassiveDesc.Desc: Max Sanity is 45, minimum is -45 The higher this unit's Sanity, the more likely it rolls maximum values The lower this unit's Sanity, the more likely it rolls minimum values If Sanity falls too low, Low Morale and Panic take effect Low Morale - Gain 1 Feeble and 2 Protection Panic - Gain 2 Feeble and 4 Protection If this unit is in Panic, restore Sanity to 0 at the start of next Scene This unit's Panic type cannot be changed

PassiveDesc.Name: King of Needleworks
PassiveDesc.Desc: If there are other allied units on the field, halve damage taken by this unit Immune to Seal and Stun; damage from negative effects on this unit is reduced by 50% When this unit takes more than 30 damage, the excess is reduced by 60% This unit's damage resistances cannot be changed by external effects

PassiveDesc.Name: Handmade
PassiveDesc.Desc: For each ally other than self on the field, gain +1 Power with all dice If an enemy has 5 or more Naildle, use "Pick stitch too obvious, you say?! I'll pick-stitch your ass!" If an enemy is Taxidermized, use "Just... Eat!!" (Naildle: When taking Pierce damage, gain +1 Bleed Count and reduce this effect's Stack by 1. Turn End: Gain Bleed equal to this effect's Stack and reduce its Stack by 1) (Taxidermized: Cannot act. When hit, gain 3 Bleed. Turn End: Take damage equal to 20% of max HP and reduce this effect's Stack by 1. When this effect expires, remove Naildle from self)

PassiveDesc.Name: Unending, Unavoidable Stream of Customer Complaints
PassiveDesc.Desc: A cry comes from the light of the Library The cry is heard every 3 Scenes When the cry is heard - Gain "Cry of the Cocoon - Frail" - Immune to Stagger HP cannot fall below 65%; upon reaching 65% HP, enter the next phase Upon entering the next phase - Remove every negative effect from self - Restore Sanity to 30 - The cry will not cease - Gain "Cry of the Cocoon - Vicious" instead - Immediately summon Needlekin once (Cry of the Cocoon - Frail: The Cocoon is crying intermittently. Immune to Power Nullification. Skill Final Power +2) (Cry of the Cocoon - Vicious: The Cocoon does not cease its cries. Immune to Power Nullification. Skill Final Power +3)

PassiveDesc.Name: The Sewing Commences
PassiveDesc.Desc: At the start of each Scene, inflict "Tongue-pinning Needle" on 2 random enemies (Tongue-pinning Needle: Lasts 1 Scene. At the end of this Scene, if this unit has not used an Attack die, halve its Naildle; otherwise, inflict 3 Naildle on self)

PassiveDesc.Name: Shower of Stinging Sunshine[King of Needleworks]
PassiveDesc.Desc: Increase the max HP and max Stagger Resist of all Librarians Influenced by the light of the Library, restore 20 Sanity at the start of each Scene At the start of the encounter, gain "Shower of Stinging Sunshine [King of Needleworks]" (Shower of Stinging Sunshine [King of Needleworks]: Gain +1 Power with all dice for every 3 Naildle on the target)

PassiveDesc.Name: Sewing
PassiveDesc.Desc: When a Pierce die hits a target, 33% chance to inflict 1 Naildle on it

PassiveDesc.Name: Tiny and Sharp Nails
PassiveDesc.Desc: When hitting a target with Naildle, inflict 1 additional Bleed on it

PassiveDesc.Name: Shower of Stinging Sunshine [Haute Couture::King of Needleworks]
PassiveDesc.Desc: [Exclusive passive for the crossover Mod "Red and Black" - Haute Couture::Le Rouge - King of Needleworks Heathcliff] At the start of the Act, gain [Shower of Stinging Sunshine - Le Rouge - King of Needleworks] At the start of each Scene, inflict [Tongue-pinning Needle] on 2 random enemies Can gain Cry effects even without [Haute Couture::Le Rouge - The Crimson God] Every 3 Scenes, Cry effects are enhanced for 1 Scene -Gain +1 additional Power with all dice -Deal +10% additional damage -Deal +5% more damage for every 10 [Tiny and Sharp Nails] on self (Shower of Stinging Sunshine - Le Rouge - King of Needleworks: Gain +1 Power with all dice for every 3 combined [Naildle] and [Abject] on the target (Max +3)) (Tongue-pinning Needle: Take +5% damage. At the end of this Scene, inflict 2 [Naildle] on self and remove this effect)
